normalized_row_contracts.profile_semantics: Profiles list the minimum common target paths for a registry family; content-specific recipes, OBJ/MTL assets and multi-sample sounds are declared by their owning data generators or recipe target_paths and are not inferred here.

legacy_state_schema_rules.target_state_projection: fixed/owning/internal owners reuse legacy ordinal; flattened variants use the same target index; per-owner flattening expands owner-major
legacy_state_schema_rules.target_id_projection: target_ids lists every owning or flattened target ID; target_id_mode defines how owners are selected
legacy_state_schema_rules.stage_semantics: stage is the earliest implementing phase; owner_stages is authoritative when one legacy schema spans multiple phases

target_id_modes.fixed_owner: exactly one target owner; target_states has one entry per legacy metadata ordinal
target_id_modes.internal_owner: exactly one non-obtainable target owner; target_states has one entry per legacy metadata ordinal
target_id_modes.owning_content: one or more target owners share the complete target_states ordinal projection
target_id_modes.flattened_variant: target_ids and target_states each have exactly one entry per legacy metadata ordinal
target_id_modes.flattened_variant_per_owner: owner_groups partitions target_ids; every owner group has one target ID per legacy metadata ordinal and target_states expands every owner/ordinal pair

legacy_state_schemas.notes: Every owner resolves through its semantic block mapping; owner_stages keeps the 0.3 electrical, 0.4 transport, and 0.5 machine acceptance gates distinct.
Horizontal orientation is projected to the vanilla horizontal facing property; owner_stages assigns each owner to its actual vertical-slice acceptance gate.
The legacy enum names are counterintuitive: CENTER_* stores center=false while NO_CENTER_* stores center=true; the target preserves the actual source field as master.
Facing and activity split into standard facing and lit properties.
The target stores the finite reserve in the oil-deposit block entity payload (schema_version plus remaining_millibuckets), not in a blockstate, while retaining all eleven observable reserve steps.
Metadata variants become independent semantic registry IDs.
Metadata variants become independent semantic casing or part IDs.
All three legacy axis states map to the target pillar axis.
The same three-value schema is flattened independently for limestone and burnt limestone.
Both visible metadata variants become independent IDs.
All sixteen controllers share the same split facing and formed state contract.
The machine activity flag becomes the standard lit state for both heater owners.

legacy_state_schemas.evidence: DecayMode.values() is assigned to the legacy air_bubble builder; OFF is stable and ON removes the bubble during scheduled or random decay ticks.
legacy_state_schemas.notes: air_bubble remains non-obtainable internal content, but its stable-versus-decaying gameplay state must be rebuilt under the internal magneticraft:air_bubble owner.
The hidden middle and top values are required structural states of the public tower.
Eight base directions and four non-obtainable vertical segments remain uniquely mapped for both pole owners.
The vertical level and horizontal direction remain separate bounded robot state.

shared_infrastructure_exceptions.reason: These are non-obtainable shared framework discriminators whose payload always carries the concrete owning content ID; they are not public block or item IDs.
A shared block entity implementation owns multiple concrete block IDs; persistence and capability dispatch still serialize the concrete block state.

exclusions.evidence: The released project registers the capability but has no gameplay consumer.
Internal runtime placeholders are not obtainable content; later implementations may preserve the internal semantic without exposing the legacy registry entry.
The conveyor and kiln paths were unfinished; BuildCraft and binary Java compatibility are out of scope; unrestricted outbound sockets violate the bounded device-bus security contract.
